title: ESO VLT/MUSE science cube ADP.2016-06-20T21:41:31.322 of Eta Carinae (2014 December 12)

evidence.locator: ObsCore row: proposal 094.D-0215(A), target eta Car, MUSE cube, released 2015-12-12, about 17.9 GB. The file's header: DATE-OBS 2014-12-12T07:44:35.890, PRODCATG SCIENCE.CUBE.IFS, wide-field mode, 0.2 arcsec spaxels, 1.25 Angstrom channels from 4750 Angstrom. Its H-beta channels give the outer ejecta's line-of-sight speeds (Mehner et al. 2016's deep data).

statements.text: Based on observations collected at the European Organisation for Astronomical Research in the Southern Hemisphere under ESO programme 094.D-0215(A).
